test.title: A gadget you use every day

document.cue: Describe a piece of technology that you use a lot.

text: I'd like to talk about my laptop, which I've been using for about three years. I bought it just before I started university, and my parents helped me pay for it. It's a fairly light silver one, so I can carry it around easily in my backpack.

I use it almost every day, mainly for studying. I write essays, search for information and join online classes on it. In my free time, I also watch films and edit photos, which is a kind of hobby for me. The battery lasts around six hours, which is enough for a normal day. Of course, it's not perfect. Sometimes it gets quite slow when I open too many programs, and the fan makes a strange noise, but I've learnt to live with that. I also love how quiet it is, because I can work late at night without disturbing my family. Another thing I like is the large screen, which is much better for my eyes than a phone.

The main reason it matters to me is that it connects almost everything in my life: my studies, my friends and my entertainment. Without it, I would have to spend hours in the library, and I'd miss a lot of opportunities. Actually, I recently got a part-time job translating texts, and I do it entirely on this laptop. So it's not just a gadget; it's really a tool that helps me earn money and improve my skills.

tips.en: Every bullet is covered in order, so the talk sounds complete.
tips.kk: Жоспардың әр тармағы ретімен ашылған, сондықтан әңгіме тұтас естіледі.
tips.ru: Каждый пункт плана раскрыт по порядку, поэтому рассказ звучит целостно.
tips.example: I'd like to talk about my laptop, which I've been using for about three years

tips.en: Honest drawbacks make the talk realistic.
tips.example: Sometimes it gets quite slow when I open too many programs

tips.en: A conditional shows what life would be like without it.
tips.kk: Шартты сөйлем құрылғысыз не болатынын көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Условное предложение показывает, что было бы без устройства.
tips.example: Without it, I would have to spend hours in the library

note.en: Introduction: what the device is, when you got it and what it looks like.
note.kk: Кіріспе: бұл қандай құрылғы, қашан алынды және қандай көрінеді.
note.ru: Вступление: что это за устройство, когда куплено и как выглядит.

note.en: Body: what you use it for, with strengths and weaknesses.
note.kk: Негізгі бөлім: оны не үшін қолданатыныңыз, артықшылықтары мен кемшіліктері.
note.ru: Основная часть: для чего вы его используете, плюсы и недостатки.

note.en: Conclusion: why the device matters to you personally.
note.kk: Қорытынды: құрылғының дәл сіз үшін неге маңызды екені.
note.ru: Заключение: почему устройство важно именно для вас.

bullets: and explain why it is important to you.
